What once was, shall be again.

Humid air chokes and twists everything it touches.

Live by the power of Corruption... die by madness.
Poisoned trees bear pestilent fruits.
Bright colours hide the rot beneath.
Life still clings to the highest places.
The land returns the dead as easily as it received them.

These gates have facilitated many trades. Silks, spices, and now horrors.
The Temporal's tongue captures the ear of those vying for power.
The ground shifts underfoot with disturbing ease.
The waters have returned, but no empire remains to greet them.
Haunting echoes carry a song of sorrow...
The grandest sculptures are carved with neither hammer nor chisel.
Dark energies congeal the lifeblood of the forest.
Fishermen once reaped a rich bounty here.
Those killed in battle do not rest peacefully.
Spores dance through the air in search of new hosts.
The felling continues, unto insanity.
Darkness always finds its way into the minds of the weak.

We know the minds of generations past only by the works they left behind.
They dig not to discover, but to escape.
Violent seas and hungry shores devour vessels, crew and all.
No living hands ever stoked these flames.
Time overwhelms even the sturdiest walls.
Beware a chill colder than death itself.
Fell blooms and grasping roots grow in shadow.
Avarice in the conqueror builds contempt among the conquered.
Sturdy walls held out an armada, but not the famine it brought.
Shafts of light raise life where they fall.
The work of an invisible empire.
The chill is second only to the stench.
Embers swirl as bark crackles and sparks.
The last vestiges of earth, lost beyond the sky.
The grandest of monuments, standing proudly before an audience of none.
Darkness enshrouds these endless chasms.
Bleak heights overlook a devastated land.
A dark labyrinth of steel and stone.
These waters devour the same souls they feed.
It continues still, its purpose unknown.
These halls weren't meant for you...
One cannot take life without the power to create it.

A sanctuary for the unsanctified.

A garden bereft of its gardener still grows as it pleases.
Restless prisoners yearn for freedom.
They scrabble and dig; they know not why...
A mad Thane rules over ruin.
The sea returns everything eventually. Even the dead.
This cavern burns hot and deadly.
There is no how, or why, or when. Only awe.

In the end, the river will always conquer the dam.
Aeons of wear have rotted steel to its core.

A haven for seabirds. A hazard for sailors.
Wild lands spurn those who claim to rule them.
The fetid home of foul generations.
Where nomads share tales of a time before drought.
Spirits gather where the world falls away.
The air is acrid. The skin burns. No doubt... sulphite.
Calm, bleak twilight holds only despair.
Stagnant oils mix to form a deadly concoction.
There is no bleaker tundra than a city at night.
Vast lairs of silk span the treetops.
In these lands, a pure water source is the most valuable treasure.
The tears of a ravaged earth.
Even the sparse vegetation does not linger here long.
Merchants and pirates alike need a safe port to peddle their wares.
Beasts of many kinds sought shelter one final time.
